description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pohaddaramulla, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530014
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property details. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) and is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
